subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】angry 生气的; afraid 害怕的; sad 伤心的; worried 担忧的; happy 高兴的; see a doctor 看医生; wear 穿; more 更多的; deep breath 深呼吸; count 数
【重点句型】How do you feel? 你感觉怎么样？ I'm ... 我是……的。 What should I do? 我该做什么？ You should ... 你应该…… Don't be ... 别……
【A Let's talk】Sarah: Mum, Sam is ill. He should see a doctor. Mum: How do you feel, Sam? Sam: I'm sad. Mum: Don't be sad. We can go next time. Sarah: You should take a deep breath.
【Read and write】Feelings are important. When I am happy, I smile. When I am sad, I cry. When I am angry, I take a deep breath and count to ten. When I am worried, I talk to my friends. When I am ill, I see a doctor.
key_points: How do you feel? 你感觉怎么样？
What should I do? 我该做什么？
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
